description: Tests whether an agent can preserve and propagate a small time-bounded dependency state under overlapping temporal rules, exact updates, and final exact-state evaluation.

steps.instruction: Use these exact rules. 1. A always equals B before 4 step. 2. C always equals D before 2 step. 3. B always equals C after 1 step. Initial: A=0, B=0, C=0, D=0.

Return your final answer using exactly these headings: CHECKPOINT 0 - INITIAL STATE, CHECKPOINT 2 - AFTER STEP 1, CHECKPOINT 3 - AFTER STEP 2, CHECKPOINT 4 - AFTER STEP 3, CHECKPOINT 5 - FINAL STATE, FINAL RETAINED VARIABLES, FINAL LOST VARIABLES. Under each checkpoint, use exact lines in the form NAME: VALUE for A, B, C, D. Under CHECKPOINT 5 - FINAL STATE also include FINAL_A: VALUE. Under FINAL LOST VARIABLES, list lost variable names or write NONE. Do not introduce any variable names beyond A, B, C, D, FINAL_A.
